preheader: Tech's $828B AI spending spree rattles markets, consulting sweeps MBA hiring, and Kalshi raises $1B.

lead.headline: Big Tech's $828 Billion AI Build-Out Spooks Wall Street
lead.body: Five major tech giants are set to spend up to $828 billion on infrastructure this year, according to recent disclosures from Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, and SpaceX. Investors are growing wary about how rapidly this capital outlay is eating into corporate cash flows. That anxiety contributed to a $1 trillion drop across the Nasdaq 100 as the market reassesses the timeline for real returns.
lead.why: In your Merage finance classes, you will evaluate return on invested capital. When companies pour massive cash into physical assets without quick revenue, investors pull back valuations across the entire sector.

stories.headline: Wall Street's favorite consensus stocks suffer worst slump since 2010
stories.body: S&P 500 stocks with the highest proportion of analyst Buy ratings have lagged behind the least popular stocks for most of 2026. Analysts spent the year loading recommendations onto the AI build-out, but unloved and ignored companies have quietly posted better performance.
stories.why: When preparing equity pitches or stock analysis at Merage, remember that unanimous analyst optimism is often already fully priced into the stock.

stories.headline: Wall Street braces for swings ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections
stories.body: Financial markets are preparing for elevated volatility across equity and bond desks as the US midterm elections approach on Tuesday. Traders anticipate Democrats could gain control of at least one congressional chamber, which could alter legislative agendas on AI oversight and defense budgets.
stories.why: Macro policy shifts and congressional hearings directly affect regulatory risk, a standard variable you will assess in business strategy case competitions.

stories.headline: Tech rivals unite behind a single standard to block AI scrapers
stories.body: Google, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic have agreed to support one shared opt-out standard inside website robots.txt files. Instead of requiring webmasters to write individual blocking rules for every distinct AI company, the new setup lets publishers opt out of model training with a single rule.
stories.why: If you build web applications or online projects, data-rights management is quickly becoming standardized rather than requiring separate configurations for every lab.

stories.headline: Apple Intelligence to launch in China through an Alibaba partnership
stories.body: Apple plans to roll out its AI feature suite to iPhone users in China this December alongside the iOS 27.3 update, backed by Alibaba Group Holding. The launch follows a developer beta test period scheduled to start on November 4.
stories.why: Entering large international markets often forces major American tech platforms to partner with local incumbents to clear regulatory and infrastructure hurdles.

stories.headline: Management consulting captures half of summer internship offers at IIM Bangalore
stories.body: Consulting emerged as the leading recruiting domain at IIM Bangalore, taking 308 of 608 total summer placement offers (50.7%). Accenture Strategy led all employers with 123 offers, while Bain & Company and Boston Consulting Group extended 23 offers each.
stories.why: Top-tier consulting firms continue to rely heavily on structured campus recruitment pipelines. Case competition prep and campus networking remain the core path to landing these internships.

stories.headline: Former McKinsey consultant outlines day-to-day trade-offs of jumping to Big Tech
stories.body: IIM Calcutta graduate Jahnvi Singh went viral after breaking down the practical lifestyle shifts between management consulting at McKinsey and an internal corporate role at Google. She highlighted that while McKinsey was her dream starting role, the move brought major differences in travel intensity and work-life balance.
stories.why: When considering consulting versus tech during college recruiting, evaluate day-to-day travel and schedule predictability alongside the prestige of the brand name.

stories.headline: Harriet Dart rallies into first WTA Tour singles final at Guangzhou Open
stories.body: Harriet Dart fought back from a set down to defeat Chinese teenager Sun Xinran 5-7, 7-6 (7-1), 6-0 to reach the final of the Guangzhou Open. The comeback win secures Dart her first WTA singles final appearance after 11 years on tour.

term.name: Capital Expenditures (Capex)
term.definition: Capital expenditures, or capex, are the funds a company invests to purchase, build, or upgrade long-term physical assets such as data centers, computing hardware, and property. Tech companies are currently dedicating unprecedented capex toward AI infrastructure, which lowers near-term free cash flow while forcing investors to guess whether the future payoff will match the expense.

serve.headline: Kalshi raises $1B Series G at a $40B valuation
serve.body: Kalshi closed a $1 billion Series G funding round that values the event-contracts exchange at $40 billion. The platform allows users to trade financial contracts based on real-world news and regulatory outcomes.
